benchmarkDefinition.sourceNote: Only new opt-in test code is added. Working test input was identical at compilation and subsequent diagnostic-only commit; no rebuild was performed to add commit metadata.

candidateDefinition.sourceNote: Working build inputs match committed runtime/test contents; commit metadata added without rebuilding actual tested engines.

comparisonProtocol.candidate: Not built; only measured grouping/publication and immutable derived metrics may be optimized before the comparison. Benchmark test source must stay byte-identical.
comparisonProtocol.order: Deterministic counterbalance: even pair baseline then candidate; odd pair candidate then baseline.
controls: Every observation is a separate xctest process using one actual frozen engine and a new owned copy of the original authored corpus.
Retain every run, source/input/engine/corpus hash, warmup and outlier. Verify original corpus hashes before/after and canonical memory rows unchanged in every copied trial.

Cache warmup is explicitly outside traversal measurements. All INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE and canonical memories.payload reads are denied during traversal. Verify every expected source ID, loaded-count sequence and metric checksum.

Measure worker SQL duration, busy=false through loaded-status publication, completion wall time including 1ms polling, and a separate all-loaded-group derived-metric sweep. Publication excludes deferred cleanup/rendering.
This is not physical GUI/frame/vsync/input latency, OS-cold startup, speech, energy or competitive ranking evidence. Older manual-cadence soak may remain active; no machine-isolation claim.
No stopping/restarting immutable successful controls for metadata; failed attempts remain retained. Disk reserve at least16GiB before each copy.

qualification.scope: Selected committed-source optimized/TSAN, actual owned APFS/Keychain/GPU/portable and app departure fixtures. Not whole-current-suite, hosted-native, physical/native interaction, speech, power, automatic24h or competitor ranking. Earlier owner/peer broad failures remain separate; prior twelve component renders were not rerun for this nonvisual optimization.

development-v1.scope: First development probe only, not a controlled paired benchmark.

development-v2.scope: Second development probe, different corpus, existing frozen engine; not a controlled paired benchmark.

package.scope: Normal release, local ad-hoc development app and owned empty-library CLI smoke. Separate from optimized-test engines; no notarization, physical/native interaction, power, automatic24h or release-readiness claim.

packagedScopeControl.scope: Reuses actual frozen current optimized Core test engine; its fixture invokes actual normal packaged CLI and retained v10 negative control. No rebuild or resignation of frozen engines.

developmentArchive.scope: Local ad-hoc development archive; independent exact signed-app round trip verified, no notarization or live activation.

raw.excluded: All executable engines, original/copied library databases, media, weights and credentials. Actual engine hashes and source snapshots included; binaries remain in the ignored local artifact root.

ci: Existing recorded-meeting class selector includes both new grouping methods without a workflow edit. Owned benchmark runs only with its explicit copied-corpus environment. No hosted-native success or whole-current-suite qualification is inferred.
